sermon.title: Another mystery before the creation of the world - September 18, 2022
sermon.series: Before the Foundation of the World
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Before time began God gave His calling and grace in Christ, not according to our works. He called Adam and Eve, Cain, Abraham, the good disciples and Paul the chief of sinners. Wherever you are, He knocks, supplies every need and heals; respond like Mary.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Recording begins mid-message.
